message.text: The new shared-ID Packwerk notice resolves every producer at the merged severity, rather than its own severity. A stronger guardrails sighting can therefore silence the Enola notice.

explanation.what: The new shared-ID Packwerk notice resolves every producer at the merged severity, rather than its own severity. A stronger guardrails sighting can therefore silence the Enola notice.
explanation.whatToDo: Retain severity and guardrail class per producer and resolve each sighting independently before taking the strictest result.
explanation.whyHere: This change introduces static and guardrails sightings with the same ID but different severities. With non-monotone trusted resolution tables, merging loses a blocking claim and lets a hostile Packwerk policy edit pass.

properties.failureScenario: The base lists packs/a/package.yml in policy-change-review.files, with analyserSeverity P1 and severity P2. Its guardrails resolution maps P1 to silent; static.enola maps P1 to silent and P2 to block. An author changes packs/a/package.yml to enforce_dependencies: false. Guardrails reports P1 and Enola reports P2 with the same ID. The stored merge selects P1, and #claims resolves Enola at P1 too, so both claims become silent instead of Enola blocking.
